Fusion research has also spurred development in superconducting magnets, which are now used in particle accelerators and industrial sorting equipment. These technologies have driven innovation in materials science and high-performance computing systems. While fusion power remains elusive, the iritic progress in related fields continues to inspire new applications across multiple industries. Additionally, fusion research supports international collaboration and develops engineering solutions for energy storage and grid management.
